topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Hey, I just heard the news about the building. It’s a big change, you know? Everything was fine, and now... it feels like the ground’s shifting. I’m worried about where everyone’s going to go and if it’s going to be the same without all of us around. What does this mean for us, really? I hope you’re hanging in there. I’ll call you later, we can talk more. I’m here, okay? No matter what. Just wanted you to know that.
